AA.00.0020/max-per-session.message: AA.00.0020 billed 16 times in session 1; the limit is 15

AA.00.0030/max-per-session.text: Rule AA.00.0030/max-per-session means AA.00.0030 (Home visit, first 5 min) may only be billed up to a set number of times within one session. AA.00.0030/max-per-session.message: AA.00.0030 billed 2 times in session S1; the limit is 1

AA.00.0030/not-with|AA.10.0010.text: Rule AA.00.0030/not-with means AA.00.0030 (home visit) and AA.10.0010 (synchronous telemedical consultation) cannot both be billed in the same session. AA.00.0030/not-with|CA.00.0020.text: Rule AA.00.0030/not-with means the home visit position AA.00.0030 and the GP consultation add-on CA.00.0020 cannot appear in the same session. AA.00.0040/max-per-session.message: AA.00.0040 billed 18 times in session 2; the limit is 15

AA.00.0080/max-per-180-days.message: AA.00.0080 billed 121 times within 180 days up to 2026-03-07; the limit is 120

AA.00.0080/not-with|AA.10.0010.text: Rule AA.00.0080/not-with means a medical consilium (AA.00.0080) and a synchronous telemedical consultation (AA.10.0010) may not be billed in the same session. AA.00.0080/not-with|AA.10.0010.message: AA.00.0080 may not be billed with AA.10.0010 in one session

AA.00.0080/not-with|AK.00.0120.text: Rule AA.00.0080/not-with means AA.00.0080 (medical consilium) and AK.00.0120 (supervised medication intake by non-physician staff) cannot appear in the same session. AA.10.0010/max-per-session.text: Rule AA.10.0010/max-per-session caps how often AA.10.0010, the first five minutes of a synchronous telemedical consultation, may be billed within one session. AG.00.0010/max-per-session.text: Rule AG.00.0010/max-per-session caps how often AG.00.0010 (Joint puncture, first joint) can be billed within one session. AG.00.0010/max-per-session.message: AG.00.0010 billed 3 times in session S1; the limit is 2

AG.00.0010/side-missing.text: Rule AG.00.0010/side-missing means that AG.00.0010 (joint puncture, first joint) must state whether the left, right or both sides were treated. AG.00.0010/side-missing.message: AG.00.0010 needs the side (L, R or B)

AK.00.0100/max-per-session.text: Rule AK.00.0100/max-per-session means AK.00.0100 (non-physician ophthalmological services, per minute) was billed more often within one session than the tariff permits. Such caps keep time-based billing proportionate to what can realistically be delivered in a single encounter. Check the documented minutes for that session, correct the quantity, and verify that the services weren't wrongly merged into one session.
AK.00.0100/max-per-session.message: AK.00.0100 billed 6 times in session S1; the limit is 5

AK.00.0100/max-sessions-per-360-days.text: Rule AK.00.0100/max-sessions-per-360-days caps how many separate sessions within a rolling period may include AK.00.0100, and this invoice exceeds that cap. Tariffs set such limits to prevent routine or excessive billing of time-based non-physician ophthalmological services. Check whether all sessions were genuinely separate and medically justified, and remove or correct the surplus session.
AK.00.0100/max-sessions-per-360-days.message: AK.00.0100 billed in 3 sessions within 360 days up to 2026-10-30; the limit is 2

AK.00.0120/max-per-day.text: Rule AK.00.0120/max-per-day caps how often AK.00.0120 (Supervised medication intake by non-physician staff) may be billed for one patient on a single day. Tariffs set such caps to reflect realistic care and prevent duplicate or inflated charges. Check whether entries were duplicated or wrongly dated, and reduce the billed quantity to the permitted maximum.
AK.00.0120/max-per-day.message: AK.00.0120 billed 3 times on 2026-03-06; the limit is 2

AK.00.0130/max-per-30-days.text: Rule AK.00.0130/max-per-30-days caps how often the supervised urine sample in addiction care (AK.00.0130) may be billed within a rolling 30-day window. AK.00.0130/max-per-30-days.message: AK.00.0130 billed 3 times within 30 days up to 2026-03-07; the limit is 2

CA.00.0010/max-per-session.text: Rule CA.00.0010/max-per-session means CA.00.0010 (GP consultation, first 5 min) may only appear up to a set number of times within one session. CA.00.0010/max-per-session.message: CA.00.0010 billed 2 times in session S1; the limit is 1

CA.00.0020/addon-without-parent.text: Rule CA.00.0020/addon-without-parent means CA.00.0020 was billed in a session without the main consultation CA.00.0010 it extends. Add-ons only price extra time on top of a main service, so they cannot stand alone. Check whether CA.00.0010 was omitted from that session or whether CA.00.0020 was recorded in the wrong session.
CA.00.0020/addon-without-parent.message: CA.00.0020 is an add-on to CA.00.0010, and none is billed in session S2

Age-restricted positions exist because paediatric examinations differ in content and effort from adult ones. Check the patient's date of birth and the service date, and if both are correct, bill an appropriate adult position instead.
CG.00.0010/age.message: CG.00.0010 requires age <= 16 years; not met on 2026-02-04

CG.00.0010/max-per-180-days.text: Rule CG.00.0010/max-per-180-days caps how often CG.00.0010, the comprehensive examination for children, may be billed within a rolling period. Comprehensive examinations are extensive and not meant to be repeated often, so the tariff restricts their frequency. Check whether every billed instance was truly comprehensive. Otherwise, replace the surplus ones with an appropriate shorter consultation position or remove them.
CG.00.0010/max-per-180-days.message: CG.00.0010 billed 3 times within 180 days up to 2026-04-17; the limit is 2

CG.00.0010/not-with|CG.00.0130.text: Rule CG.00.0010/not-with means CG.00.0010 and CG.00.0130 cannot appear together in the same session. The tariff forbids this because both positions cover overlapping examination work, so billing both would pay twice for the same effort. Check which examination was actually performed in that session and keep only the matching position, removing the other.

CG.00.0020/age.text: Rule CG.00.0020/age means position CG.00.0020 may only be billed when the patient's age on the service date falls within the window the tariff defines for this first-month preventive examination. Such rules keep age-specific check-ups tied to the developmental stage they were designed for. Check the patient's birth date and the service date, or bill the examination appropriate for the patient's actual age.
CG.00.0020/age.message: CG.00.0020 requires age < 1 months (+20 days); not met on 2026-03-02

CG.00.0020/max-per-patient.text: Rule CG.00.0020/max-per-patient means CG.00.0020 (Preventive examination in the first month) may be billed only a limited number of times for the same patient. The tariff restricts it because this preventive check happens once in that early life period, not repeatedly. Check whether the examination was entered twice by mistake and remove the extra entries.
CG.00.0020/max-per-patient.message: CG.00.0020 billed 2 times  for this patient; the limit is 1

CG.00.0020/only-with.text: Rule CG.00.0020/only-with means CG.00.0020 may be billed only alongside the specific positions the tariff permits as companions. Tariffs restrict combinations like this so a defined examination isn't stacked with services it already covers or doesn't fit with. Check which positions share the session and remove or correct any that aren't permitted companions.
CG.00.0020/only-with.message: CG.00.0020 may only be billed with AK.00.0010, AK.00.0020, CG.15.0010; CG.00.0170 shares the session

CG.00.0130/age.text: Rule CG.00.0130/age means position CG.00.0130 may only be billed when the patient's age on the day of service falls within the range the tariff defines for it. The tariff ties this developmental paediatric examination to young children because its content and time are calibrated for that stage. Check the patient's birth date and service date, and if correct, bill the examination under a suitable alternative position.
CG.00.0130/age.message: CG.00.0130 requires age <= 7 years; not met on 2026-01-21

CG.00.0130/max-per-360-days.text: Rule CG.00.0130/max-per-360-days caps how often CG.00.0130 may be billed for the same patient within a rolling period, counted across all prior invoices. Such caps keep time-based examinations proportionate and prevent excessive billing. Check the patient's earlier invoices for duplicated or wrongly recorded minutes, and correct or remove the excess quantity.
CG.00.0130/max-per-360-days.message: CG.00.0130 billed 391 times within 360 days up to 2026-11-12; the limit is 390

CG.00.0130/max-sessions-per-360-days.text: Rule CG.00.0130/max-sessions-per-360-days caps how many separate sessions of CG.00.0130 may be billed for the same patient within a rolling period. The tariff sets this cap because developmental examinations are periodic assessments, not ongoing treatment. Check whether every billed session really was a separate developmental examination, and remove or rebill sessions that exceed the cap.

Check the session and keep only the position that reflects the service actually provided, removing the other.
CG.00.0130/not-with|CG.00.0170.message: CG.00.0130 and CG.00.0170 may not be billed in one session; each position's rules exclude the other (CG.00.0130/not-with, CG.00.0170/not-with)

CG.00.0170/age.text: Rule CG.00.0170/age means position CG.00.0170 may only be billed when the patient's age on the day of service falls within the range the tariff allows. Growth assessment is meaningful only while a patient is still growing, so the tariff restricts it to young patients. Check the patient's date of birth and the service date, and remove or replace the position if they are correct.
CG.00.0170/age.message: CG.00.0170 requires age <= 20 years; not met on 2026-01-06

CG.00.0170/max-per-360-days.text: Rule CG.00.0170/max-per-360-days caps how often the growth assessment CG.00.0170 may be billed for one patient within a rolling period. Tariffs set such limits because routine growth checks need only periodic repetition. Check whether earlier assessments, possibly billed by colleagues, already used the allowance, and remove or correct the surplus entry.
CG.00.0170/max-per-360-days.message: CG.00.0170 billed 3 times within 360 days up to 2026-09-21; the limit is 2

CG.10.0010/age.text: Rule CG.10.0010/age means position CG.10.0010 may only be billed when the patient's age on the day of service falls within the range the tariff defines for this pediatric ear canal cleaning. Tariffs restrict such positions because the effort and valuation are calibrated for children. Check the patient's date of birth and the service date, and if both are correct, bill the appropriate non-pediatric position instead.
CG.10.0010/age.message: CG.10.0010 requires age <= 12 years; not met on 2026-01-15

CG.10.0010/max-per-session.text: Rule CG.10.0010/max-per-session means CG.10.0010 was billed more often within one session than the tariff allows. The cap exists because the position is defined per ear side, so a session can only justify a limited count. Check whether entries were duplicated or belong to another session, and correct the quantity accordingly.
CG.10.0010/max-per-session.message: CG.10.0010 billed 3 times in session S1; the limit is 2

CG.10.0010/side-missing.text: Rule CG.10.0010/side-missing means position CG.10.0010 is billed per side, so each line must state whether the left ear, the right ear or both were treated. The tariff requires this because per-side services can only be checked and paid correctly when the side is known. Add the missing side indicator to the line, as documented in the patient record.
CG.10.0010/side-missing.message: CG.10.0010 needs the side (L, R or B)

GA.00.0010/max-per-day.text: Rule GA.00.0010/max-per-day caps how often GA.00.0010, the radiation protection flat rate for high-dose imaging, may be billed for one patient on a single day. The flat rate already covers the protection effort for that day, so repeated charges would double-bill it. Check whether extra entries were duplicated or wrongly dated, and remove those exceeding the daily limit.
GA.00.0010/max-per-day.message: GA.00.0010 billed 3 times on 2026-03-06; the limit is 2

GA.00.0010/max-per-session.text: Rule GA.00.0010/max-per-session means GA.00.0010 (Radiation protection flat rate, high-dose imaging) was billed more often within one session than the tariff allows. The flat rate covers radiation protection for the whole session, so repeated billing would pay twice for the same work. Check the session and remove the surplus entries, or correct the session assignment if separate sessions occurred.
GA.00.0010/max-per-session.message: GA.00.0010 billed 2 times in session S2; the limit is 1

GK.05.0050/max-per-session.text: Rule GK.05.0050/max-per-session means GK.05.0050 (Ultrasound, external male genital system) was billed more often within one session than the tariff allows. The tariff caps it per session because a single examination already covers the whole region, so repeated charges would double-bill one service. Check whether the extra entries are duplicates or belong to a separate session, and correct the invoice accordingly.
GK.05.0050/max-per-session.message: GK.05.0050 billed 2 times in session S2; the limit is 1

GK.05.0050/sex.text: Rule GK.05.0050/sex means position GK.05.0050 (Ultrasound, external male genital system) may only be billed for patients recorded as male, because the examined anatomy exists only in that sex. Check whether the patient's sex in the invoice data is correct; if it is, replace the position with the one that matches the examination actually performed.
GK.05.0050/sex.message: GK.05.0050 is for male patients only

GK.10.0050/max-per-session.text: Rule GK.10.0050/max-per-session means GK.10.0050 (ultrasound cervical length measurement in pregnancy) was billed more often within one session than the tariff allows. Such limits exist because one examination covers the measurement, so repeated billing would overstate the service. Check for duplicate entries in that session and remove the excess, or assign it to its correct separate session.
GK.10.0050/max-per-session.message: GK.10.0050 billed 2 times in session S1; the limit is 1

GK.10.0050/sex.text: Rule GK.10.0050/sex means GK.10.0050 (ultrasound cervical length measurement in pregnancy) may only be billed for female patients. The tariff restricts it because the service is clinically possible only in pregnancy. Check whether the patient's sex is recorded correctly in the patient data, and whether the right patient or the right position was billed.
GK.10.0050/sex.message: GK.10.0050 is for female patients only

VE.05.0010/max-per-session.text: Rule VE.05.0010/max-per-session caps how often VE.05.0010 (Bladder catheterisation, boy or man) may be billed within a single session, because the tariff values the procedure as one complete service per encounter. Check whether duplicate entries were recorded for the same session, remove the excess lines, or assign a genuinely separate procedure to its correct session.
VE.05.0010/max-per-session.message: VE.05.0010 billed 2 times in session S1; the limit is 1

VE.05.0010/sex.text: Rule VE.05.0010/sex means position VE.05.0010 (Bladder catheterisation, boy or man) may only be billed for a male patient. The tariff ties some positions to sex because the procedure and its effort differ by anatomy. Check that the patient's recorded sex is correct, and if the patient is female, bill the matching position for female patients instead.
VE.05.0010/sex.message: VE.05.0010 is for male patients only
